meta.name: defi-protocol-templates
meta.description: Implement DeFi protocols with production-ready templates for staking, AMMs, governance, and flash loans. Use when building decentralized finance applications or smart contract protocols.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用生产级模板实现 DeFi 协议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发区块链应用，需要搭建 DeFi 协议
copy.tagline_en: Use production-ready templates to build DeFi protocols
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building blockchain applications and need to implement DeFi protocols

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按模板给出 Solidity 合约代码,覆盖质押奖励分发、AMM 自动做市、治理代币和闪电贷这几类 DeFi 协议;更细的模板和示例在 references/details.md 里,需要时会去读。
howto.when: 当你在开发去中心化金融应用或智能合约协议时会触发,比如搭建质押平台、实现 AMM,或做治理代币系统、接入闪电贷。

say.text: 帮我写一个带奖励分发的质押合约模板
给我一个 AMM 合约,能加流动性、移除和兑换
say.note: 输出 SimpleAMM 代码,内含 0.3% 手续费

say.text: 做一个治理代币系统,给个合约模板
say.note: 按模板给出治理代币的实现结构

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude outputs Solidity contract templates for DeFi protocols: staking with reward distribution, AMMs, governance tokens, and flash loans. It can also read references/details.md for more patterns and worked examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are building decentralized finance applications or smart contract protocols, such as a staking platform, an AMM, a governance token system, or flash loan integration.

say_en.text: Write me a staking contract template with reward distribution
Give me an AMM contract that adds, removes liquidity and swaps
say_en.note: Returns SimpleAMM code with a 0.3% fee

say_en.text: Give me a governance token system contract template
